silhouette.reason: Five necks with spiked crests and horned heads on a sprawling four-legged body read as a hydra; one head hangs low in front of the chest in hero.png and muddles the leg silhouette.
fixes: raise the lowest neck so all five heads separate above the shoulders in the 3/4 view
larger dorsal spines along the back

proportions.reason: Legs are thin and splayed for a 7.7 m animal; the trunk is small against five long necks and a long tail, and the chest has a pendulous blob between the forelegs in FRONT.
fixes: thicken the upper legs ~25 % and pull the feet under the body
flatten the chest bulge under the neck roots

materials.reason: One olive skin with a lighter belly and paler belly scutes; horns, claws and teeth separate only by hue.
fixes: scale strip (or normal) on the back and a separate keratin roughness for horns and claws
darker dorsal saddle pattern to break the uniform olive

detail.reason: Crests, horns, claws, teeth and belly scutes read; the skin between is smooth and uniform.
fixes: scale rows along the necks and plates on the back
gums and tongue in the open mouths

wear.reason: No scars, broken horns or grime.
fixes: a stump (cauterised) or scarred neck, chipped horns
mud on the feet and belly

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps all five necks and the outline; heads simplify to wedges.
fixes: keep the horn pairs as cones at LOD2

technical.reason: QA clean; 348k / 39k / 7.2k tris: LOD0 is very heavy for an in-game creature and drops 9× to LOD1.
fixes: lower neck and tail ring counts at LOD0 to ~120k total
spend saved triangles on the heads
